<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914059_theRebbe_310" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914059_theRebbe_310__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>After the ascent of teshuvah, one must draw down the light from above through Torah and mitzvos, thereby bringing all spiritual and physical blessings and making a dwelling for G-d below.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is also what the verse continues: "and return to Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="1">that after the teshuvah of "Return, O Israel, unto Havayah your G-d," which is an elevation from below to above,</t>
    <t s="2">there must be "and return to Havayah,"</t>
    <t s="3">to draw down the light from above downward through Torah and mitzvos, which are the way of Havayah.</t>
    <t s="4">And through this,</t>
    <t s="5">they draw down all the influences not only in spiritual matters but also in physical matters,</t>
    <t s="6">in children, life, and ample sustenance,</t>
    <t s="7">as the Alter Rebbe said,</t>
    <t s="8">"The Almighty gives Jews physicality, and Jews make from that physicality spirituality,"</t>
    <t s="9">and they make a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="10">and through this—"And Havayah shall be King over all the earth."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: After the ascent of teshuvah, one must draw down the light from above through Torah and mitzvos, thereby bringing all spiritual and physical blessings and making a dwelling for G-d below.

translations.translation: And this is also what the verse continues: "and return to Havayah,"
that after the teshuvah of "Return, O Israel, unto Havayah your G-d," which is an elevation from below to above,
there must be "and return to Havayah,"
to draw down the light from above downward through Torah and mitzvos, which are the way of Havayah.
they draw down all the influences not only in spiritual matters but also in physical matters,
in children, life, and ample sustenance,
"The Almighty gives Jews physicality, and Jews make from that physicality spirituality,"
and they make a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms,
and through this—"And Havayah shall be King over all the earth."
